topic.source_contract: Higher-risk-building scope, BSR building-control approval, change control, golden thread, completion certification and mandatory occurrence reporting

facts.scope: BSR building-control approval route for new and existing higher-risk buildings
facts.guard: an application is not approval and planning permission is separate

facts.completion: full or partial completion certificate after completed work
facts.guard: physical completion is not a certificate or occupation permission

facts.information: controlled, accurate and transferable building information
facts.guard: document presence is not proof of regulatory compliance

facts.reporting: fire-spread and structural safety occurrences meeting the reporting threshold
facts.guard: a report does not replace remediation or approval

facts.framework: current design and construction guidance collection
facts.guard: gateway stages and occupation duties remain separate

scope_guards: Planning permission is not treated as BSR building-control approval.
A submitted Gateway 2 application is not treated as an approved application.
Approved design information is not treated as compliant as-built work.
A change log is not treated as accepted change control.
Physical completion is not treated as a completion certificate.
A completion certificate is not treated as registration of an occupied residential HRB.
A mandatory occurrence report is not treated as remediation or closure.
No score or promotion is written without exact building scope, approvals, controlled changes, certificate, registration and operational evidence.
